Regarding the civilization and education of truth, it is a great necessity for the well-being of the Pashtun and the Pashtun himself that steps be taken at the national level to establish a system that creates a broad and standard education system for the people of the country. This is a path in which every citizen of the country can obtain their right. For the importance of this education, it is necessary that efforts be made at the national level to create a curriculum that enhances the mental abilities of the people. Its goal should be the promotion of science and knowledge for the progress of the homeland, not just for a specific class. The current system that exists pays attention to the interests of a specific class, due to which many members of our society are left without education. We must try to ensure that education is in accordance with the needs of the people and that every citizen can benefit from the blessings of education in their own country. No matter how many obstacles there are in this path, we must move forward for a bright future and work for the progress of our country in the light of knowledge. Our goal should not just be building schools, but creating an environment in which everyone has equal opportunity for learning. With this, every individual in our society will participate in the progress of the country and a strong society will be created.
687.left:
A short note on the great need for the development of true civilization and education:

In reality, national education is an essential step for the common interests of all and the well-being of society. Unfortunately, the current system in the field of education has a series of shortcomings, due to which the people of the country remain deprived of their true right. In these circumstances, a major change is needed in the field of education that will open the doors of knowledge for every citizen of the country. Current education is for a limited circle, while education as a social right should reach everyone. For the development of education, it is necessary to formulate policies at the government level that take into account the needs of the people and take practical steps for the progress of the country. In this way, the people of our society will not only be equipped with the light of knowledge, but will also shine in the world as a strong and developed society. It is the duty of every Pashtun to strive for the popularization of education and to raise their voice for this important task.

On May 28, 1939, the twenty-first independence celebration of the Pashtun nation
was completed with glory, splendor, and happiness. On this
in Peshawar, Mr. Muhammad Hakim Khan Sahib, a lawyer, invited the Pashtuns
and held a grand feast in honor of the respected Pashtuns. And on the
occasion of the feast, the honorable Khan Muhammad Hakim Khan, [to the] respected guests
spoke in praise of Pashto. In it, the memorable name
of Ghazi Muhammad Nadir Khan, the conqueror, and his eternal achievements were described. And the current
King, His Majesty Muhammad Zahir Shah's government's blessings were explained
by him - and along with it, the highness of Sardar Muhammad Hashim Khan Sahib
and His Highness Sardar Shah Wali Khan and His Highness Sardar Shah
Mahmud Khan's great achievements were praised - and the ceremony
ended with great happiness.

and pray for the soul of the freedom-loving Pashtun nation.

A look at Albania

Albania's (late) King "Ahmed Zogu" is one of those figures of the world who, due to his merit and courage, rose above his ordinary status.

This king's story is the story of the death of Jelal Bey, among the tribes of Albania. Besides his status as a merchant, Jelal Bey was also the trusted deputy of Sultan Abdul Hamid. He was born in 1895. Ahmed Zogu was educated in the Albanian way. Until 1915, Albania was part of the Turkish government. But when a freedom movement started against the Sultan's corrupt government in Turkey, Ahmed Zogu began to think about the freedom of his own country. At the age of twenty, he joined the movement. He endured exile, imprisonment, and the hardships of war. Finally, he succeeded in his goal. In 1924 he became the Prime Minister of Albania, and in 1925 he became the head of Albania. Finally, in 1928, due to his ability and power, he was made King of Albania, and he took the title "Zogu".

During the time of the freedom movement, he faced many enemies. The people of Albania, like the Wazirs, believed in blood feuds. Controlling these bloodthirsty people was not an easy task. Ahmed Zogu was a brave man. He was successful in controlling them. He was always cautious about his enemies. There were reports of him killing three hundred (300) people. Many attempts were made to assassinate him, but fate saved him, and he remained alive.

He kept his palace under the protection of machine guns and often did not participate in public meetings.

Ahmed Zogu was a very learned man. He could speak German, French, Turkish, and Serbian. He was fond of studying history and spent his lonely nights busy with work for the betterment of the country.

Zogu was very skilled in maintaining law and order among the people. He brought his enemies under control through his good behavior. Whenever he found out that someone intended to rebel, he would invite them to the palace and bring them under control through his polite behavior.

A priest, Fan Noli, was his very staunch enemy. When Zogu came to power, he exiled him. He lived in America for a long time. Finally, he became very ill, and the money for his treatment ---

A message of condolence from Pashtun
The struggle of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan for the service of the nation is an example that will always be a torch for future generations. He spent most of his life for the unity of the Pashtuns and for winning their rights. In his death, not only his family but the entire Pashtun nation is in grief. Remembering his services and following his path is the duty of every Pashtun. We pray for his forgiveness at the threshold of God. May God Almighty grant patience to his family and all his friends. Amen.

A message of condolence from Pashtun on the death of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan
Alas and a hundred times alas that today a great leader like Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan, a fighter for the path of the nation's freedom who always raised his voice against the oppression and tyranny of the British, is no longer among us to understand the heart's pain and sorrow of the nation. His passing is a great tragedy for the entire nation. In this grief, not only his family and friends but all those who dreamed of the independence and prosperity of the homeland are in mourning. The history of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan's life and struggle is a bright example for those who are ready to sacrifice their lives for the path of truth and reality. With his death, a page of the struggles of Pashtunkhwa has been turned. May God have mercy on him and grant him a place in Paradise. We express our sympathy to his family and survivors in this grief.

Those Pashtuns who strive for a specific development in recognizing their ethnicity and rights, and in the path of protecting the interests of all, it is necessary for them never to show weakness in recognizing their rights in their social affairs in the light of knowledge and truth. They must, in order to protect their national and ethnic interests, prevent the conspiracies of their enemies in all circumstances by maintaining a spirit of unity and cooperation with one another, and be ready to make any sacrifice for the service of their homeland and their people.

Protecting the rights of the Pashtun nation
In recent times, many atrocities and excesses have been committed against Pashtuns, but to prevent this, it is necessary to raise a strong voice for the unity of Pashtuns and the protection of their rights. Our people must understand that their rights are not at anyone's mercy, but are achieved as a result of their own efforts and unity. If we want to live in this world as an honorable nation, then we must rise as an organized force to demand our rights.

898.right:
In Memory of Tipu Sultan

30
August 1939

In a state where the dark clouds of slavery were spread over many parts of India, in a corner of the Indian soil known as Mysore, a shining star rose that lit the lamp of hope for freedom in the hearts of Indians. This shining star was "Tipu Sultan," who had dedicated his entire life to the path of freedom.

Tipu Sultan was not only a wise politician but also a brave military leader. He understood that for the freedom of India, a disciplined and united voice was needed against the British. He established contacts with leaders from various parts of India and urged them to stand against colonialism.

An important part of his life is his confrontation with the British. He defeated the British armies in many battles and halted their expansionist policies. His bravery and perseverance were a source of inspiration for the people of that time.

But unfortunately, due to some traitors and those who sided with foreigners, Tipu Sultan joined the ranks of martyrs in a crucial battle. His death was a great loss to the struggle for India's freedom, but his message and love for freedom remained forever in the hearts of Indians.

In conclusion, we can say that Tipu Sultan's struggle is an excellent example of an untiring effort for the truth. He believed that freedom is the right of every human being and that it is permissible to make any sacrifice for this right. Although he is not among us today, his achievements and his love for the homeland are written forever in our history.

It is essential for us to learn from the life of Tipu Sultan that we should always have a spirit of sacrifice for the freedom and dignity of our homeland. If we want to leave a dignified and free India for our future generations, we must follow in the footsteps of such leaders who sacrificed their lives for truth and justice.

This lamp of freedom that Tipu Sultan lit must be kept alive by all of us together today. It is our national duty to keep the memory of such heroes fresh and work for the progress of our country according to their guidance. The soul of Tipu Sultan will be happy when we stand on our own feet for the freedom and survival of our homeland.

The situation in foreign countries
The confrontation between Germany and France. According to news from London, it has become known that German troops are gathering in three large border regions of Germany. The German army has moved towards the southern side of Moselle and Saarbrücken. The confrontation between the French and German armies has begun, and both sides are fighting. One report says that on the Siegfried Line, there is not much activity, and the French are fighting with great bravery. A military expert has estimated the power of both governments, stating that Germany has 100,000 soldiers on the front line, while France has 500,000 soldiers prepared for war. From a French announcement, it has become known that Germany will attack the French with great force, as France has occupied territory beyond the border, and they will certainly try to reclaim it. If they attack Saarbrücken, they might suffer a loss of 100,000 troops, although the French have made great preparations. The gathering of Russian troops: London reports that Russian troops have gathered on the borders of Baku and the Caucasus, but it is not yet clear what this means. 976.right:
Situation in foreign countries
War preparations in Iran and Iraq: The Al-Ahram newspaper writes that war preparations are underway in Iran. There are reports of a large military buildup in Qazvin, Khorasan, and Isfahan. There are reports of military concentration along the Iranian border in the areas of Iraq or towards the deserts of western Iraq. In this regard, there are also reports of some other military activities in the eastern and northern parts of Iran. This is a matter of great concern, because as a result of these measures, a kind of tension may arise in the relations between Iran and these countries.
The new series of talks regarding the wall and the border between Iran and Iraq is also a matter of concern. No new news has been published by the Iraqi government in this regard. However, signs of special measures being taken in response to these actions by Iran are visible. The possibility of continued conflict over the borders between the two countries is high, and regional stability is facing a threat.

1005.right:
Page 30

11 November 1931

The decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact on the people and that such talk is spreading disunity within the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kaka Khel is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kaka Khel is a person who has always played his intellectual and practical part for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Much more is being said about the aforementioned Khan regarding the document mentioned above, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1005.left:
In this regard, we strongly state that such rumors are spread to create discord among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Council that the entire nation will remain united and will work together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

1059.right:
Situation in foreign countries
War preparations in Iran and Iraq. Al-Ahram newspaper writes that war preparations are underway in Iran. There are reports of a large military buildup in Qazvin, Khorasan, and Isfahan. There are reports of military concentration along the Iranian border near the deserts of western Iraq and some areas of Iraq. In this regard, there are also reports of some other military activities in the eastern and northern parts of Iran. This is a matter of great concern, because as a result of these measures, a kind of tension may arise in the relations between Iran and these countries.
The new series of talks regarding the border and walls between Iran and Iraq is also a matter of concern. No new news has been published by the Iraqi government in this regard. However, signs of special measures being taken in response to these actions by Iran are visible. The possibility of continued conflict over the borders between the two countries is high, and regional stability is facing a threat.

1088.right:
Page 30

11 November 1931

The decision of the Great National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact on the public, and such talk is spreading disunity within the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhail is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by a spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhail is a person who has always played his intellectual and practical part for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the aforementioned Khan and the document mentioned above, much more is being said, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1088.left:
In this regard, we firmly state that such rumors are spread to create discord among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Jirga that the entire nation will remain united and will work together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

The Congress has clearly stated its policy regarding the influence exerted on India and the response given to the people of the country. The Working Committee views this with satisfaction. 11 November 1931

The decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact among the people, and such talk spreads disunity in the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Sayyid Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhel is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhel is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib’s letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the aforementioned Khan and the document mentioned above, much more is being said, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and has stood firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1151.left:
In this regard, we firmly state that such rumors are spread so that discord is created among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Council (Loya Jirga) that the entire nation will remain united and will make joint efforts to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any kind of sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

November 11, 1931

Decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A Petition

We have received news that in closed circles, such talk is spreading as if a group of people have circulated a certain article among themselves that has a very bad effect on the people, and such talk spreads disunity among the nation. We clarify these points regarding this article:

(1) Sayed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhil is a person whose words and actions have always contained the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and agreement of the nation. The accusations spread about him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhil is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations spread against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's "Pulad Spasnama" (Steel's Gratitude), it became clear that his and his friends' intention is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Much more can be said about the aforementioned Khan regarding the above-mentioned article, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1216.left:
Regarding this, we strongly say that such rumors are spread to create disunity among the people and to serve the interests of the colonizers. We call on all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

The members of the Grand National Jirga have decided that the entire nation will be united and will strive together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to national unity.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people are informed of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of foreigners.

We are firm in our goal and will not shy away from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with national unity, this path will become easier.

11 November 1931

Decision of the Grand National Assembly

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A Petition

We have received news that in some places, such talks are being published as if a group of people has published an article among themselves that leaves very bad impressions among the people, and such talks spread disunity in the nation. Regarding this article, we make these statements clear:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhel is a person in whose words and actions there has always been a spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and agreement of the nation. The accusations published about him are baseless.

(2) Mian Ataullah Sahib Kakhel is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karam Shah Sahib's Polad Spasnama, it became clear that his and his friends' intention is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the mentioned Khan, much more is being said about the above-mentioned article, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the upliftment of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1277.left:
Regarding this, we strongly say that such rumors are spread to create disunity among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

By the members of the Grand National Jirga, it has been decided in this regard that the entire nation will be united and will strive together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles in the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of foreigners.

We are firm on our goal and will not shy away from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easier.
